# Rainier Getaway

> Rainier Getaway is a group vacation rental home at 343 Skate Creek Rd N, Ashford, WA 98304, about 5 miles (10 minutes) from the Nisqually entrance of Mount Rainier National Park. It sleeps up to 12 guests in 4 bedrooms (6 beds) with 3 bathrooms, and can be booked directly (10% off platform prices) or through Airbnb and VRBO.

## The home

- Sleeps 12 guests; 4 bedrooms, 6 beds, 3 bathrooms
- Two game lofts (pool, ping pong, air hockey, arcade games, mini golf, foosball, and more), a private gym, sauna, hot tub, and fire pit
- Full kitchen, dining area, high-speed Wi-Fi, laundry, EV charger, and ample parking
- Suited to family reunions, groups of friends, retreats, and multigenerational trips

## House rules

- Two-night minimum stay; check-in 4:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM
- Pets allowed (maximum of three)
- No smoking or vaping inside; quiet hours 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM
- $800 refundable damage deposit
